::: {.callout-tip}
## Why This Matters
Founded December 2024 in Bengaluru by ex-Intel and ex-AMD engineers Dheemanth Nagaraj (CEO), Ashok Jagannathan, Srikanth Nimmagadda and Rajesh Vivekanandham, with Vinod Dham ('Father of the Pentium') as founding advisor. Raised an $8M seed round led by Peak XV Partners (January 2026). Pre-silicon.
:::

## What does this firm design?

Full-stack AI compute platform — custom GPU hardware plus software stack including compilers, libraries, system software, and AI frameworks.
